description.narrative: Pilot study collaboration between Dalarna University and Institute of Health Sciences in Hargeisa within the area of midwifery/nursing
Samarbete mellan Högskolan Dalarna och Institute of Health Sciences i Hargeisa inom barnmorske/sjuksköterskeutbildning.

The contribution started on 2013-11-01 and ended on 2016-03-30. Appraisal and follow-up was done using the old contribution management systems and the shift to the new system led to a few new areas lacking information, particularly the new questions. The expected outcome of the project was to contribute to a reduction in maternal and neonatal mortality rates by increasing the number of qualified midwifery teachers with master' degree in Somaliland and Puntland. It is not possible to determine whether the outcome objective was achieved as the programme did not stay long enough to follow-up on the graduates and monitor outcome results. Besides, the programme intervened at university level and not health facility level. Sida and dalarna university therefore, agreed not to report on outcomes but activities. The Following outputs were realized by the project: 1) 49 midwives were trained and awarded with Master Degree of Midwifery certificate. By the time of reporting from Dalarna, 84 midwifery teachers had passed their examinations. 2) A training curriculum for the web-based midwifery master programme was developed and endorsed in Somaliland 3) The capacity of the two participating Somaliland Universities was enhanced particularly the faculties of health sciences. This included the capacity to train, edit documents including journals, and also there was an improvement in ICT infrastructure that had been established as a result of the project.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
